description: Department of Local Government - Central Province - The Representation of Women as members of a Pradeshiya Sabha, Urban Council and Municipal Council appointed in accordance (Chapter 262)
categorisation: This gazette content establishes a legal framework for the creation and operation of special advisory committees on women's affairs within Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies) in the Central Province. It is an order made under specific Acts of Parliament (Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of 1987 and Provincial Councils Act, No. 12 of 1989), detailing the composition, functions, procedures, and rules for these committees. This constitutes the creation of subsidiary legislation and regulatory procedures, fitting the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette. While a government official (the Provincial Governor) is named, this is in the context of issuing a legal order, not a personnel appointment or a description of his portfolio responsibilities.
